preconditions.description: Number of computers (n) and number of cables (m) are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
preconditions.description: Each cable connects two valid computers within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The number of cables in the final scheme (p) is at least the number of original cables (m).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= n and 1 <= di <= n for ci, di in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: Each cable in the final scheme connects two valid computers within the range [1, n].
The number of cable pairs (c, d) matches the total number of cables (p).

postconditions.expression: all((ci, di) in zip(a, b) or (di, ci) in zip(a, b) for ci, di in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: Each cable in the final scheme either exists in the original plan or is a newly added cable.

postconditions.expression: all(di == ci for ci, di in zip(c, d)) or all(di != ci for ci, di in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: For each cable, information flows either in both directions or in one direction only.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for ci, di in zip(c, d) if ci == i) % 2 == 0 for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each computer has an even number of cables coming out of it.
